subject: Unstructured remittance: allocation required + UK VAT breakout
messages:
From: Olive Tech <payments@olive-tech.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:18:00Z
Subject: Payment remittance for May invoices

Hi Mateo,

Attached is our remittance for payments sent yesterday (wire reference: OT-659312). We paid a single pooled amount of GBP 78,340.00 to Redwood's UK collection account on 2027-06-01. The bank provided only one reference on their side and our ERP exported only aggregated lines — you'll find a CSV attached with our best-effort invoice mapping, but it's not authoritative.

Key notes:
- Payment date: 2027-06-01
- Bank ref: OT-659312
- Amount (GBP): 78,340.00
- VAT treatment: mixed — some invoices are B2B reverse charge, others standard 20% VAT. Our CSV includes a VAT_code column.

Please confirm which invoices were applied and whether you need additional bank evidence (we can request stamped bank advices).

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Finance Operations / Olive Tech
attachments: olive_remit_20270601.pdf, invoice_list_olive_may.csv
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@olive-tech.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T10:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Payment remittance for May invoices

Vanessa / Laura —

We received an aggregated payment from Olive Tech (OT-659312) for GBP 78,340 on 2027-06-01. The remittance they attached is unstructured and their CSV is incomplete; a few invoice IDs are missing or ambiguous. Can payments ops run a trace against the UK collection account and try to map the payment to the outstanding invoices? Specifically:

1) Prioritize matching any invoices with our VAT flag = "standard" so we can create the appropriate tax credit notes if needed.
2) If we cannot auto-match, escalate to AR for manual allocation and record a suspense entry.
3) We may need to share stamped bank advice back to Olive for their records.

Copying Daniel to keep them in the loop — Daniel, short ask: can you pull the bank-stamped remittance or a SWIFT MT103 and send if available? That will speed the match.

Thanks,
Mateo
Revenue Ops / Redwood Inference
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-07T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: RE: Payment remittance for May invoices

Following up with results from treasury: we traced OT-659312 to our Barclays GBP virtual account. Bank provided a received credit timestamp and a partial narrative but did not surface individual invoice IDs — see attached bank_receipt_20270602.png (bank screenshot).

Allocation summary (work-in-progress):
- Applied: INV-20270509 (GBP 12,420.00), INV-20270522 (GBP 8,760.00), INV-20270529 (GBP 9,360.00).
- Pending/manual: a residual bucket of GBP 47,800.00 remains unallocated.

VAT notes: our ledger marks the three applied invoices as standard-rate VAT (20%). Olive's CSV marks several lines as "reverse_charge" — we need confirmation on which specific invoice numbers are reverse charge vs. standard. If the residual contains reverse-charge invoices, we must not create VAT credit notes; instead, update tax postings and ship a remittance breakdown to Olive for their reclaim.

Next steps:
- Mateo: please authorize a manual suspense posting for GBP 47,800 and start outreach for the remaining invoice IDs.
- Laura: can AR open a ticket with collection to request SWIFT/MT103 from Olive if Daniel can produce it? That will help close the gap.

Vanessa
Payments & Treasury / Redwood Inference
attachments: bank_receipt_20270602.png
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@olive-tech.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-09T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Allocation summary and VAT flags (OT-659312)

Thanks for the update team —

We pulled the MT103 from our bank and attached it here (see olive_remit_20270601.pdf). Apologies for the CSV noise — our export flattened some debit memos. From our side:

- Confirmed invoices for standard VAT: INV-20270509, INV-20270522, INV-20270529 (matches your applied list).
- Remaining bulk (GBP 47,800) covers: INV-20270430 (GBP 15,000, reverse_charge), INV-20270501 (GBP 10,000, standard), INV-20270512 (GBP 22,800, reverse_charge).

Action items from Olive:
- We will re-issue a remittance file with explicit invoice IDs and VAT labels tomorrow.
- If Redwood needs a stamped bank advice, we can request one from our bank — should we send to treasury@redwood.com or to AR?

If you confirm the tentative allocations above we will consider the payment fully applied on our side and close the batch.

Best,
Daniel Park
Finance Operations / Olive Tech
attachments: olive_remit_20270601.pdf
